  • What you can learn from the skin diagnostic chart “RE-BEAU2”
  • Benefits of receiving a beauty skin diagnosis
  • Flow of treatment

What is skin beauty diagnosis?

At our hospital, we use the skin imaging diagnostic device "re-Beau2" to perform skin diagnosis. A 24-megapixel high-definition camera photographs the patient's face, and the patient's skin condition is analyzed based on the data.
Based on the analysis results, you can create a treatment plan that better addresses the patient's skin problems and concerns. We will not do any unnecessary upsells, so please feel free to contact us.

Do you have any problems like this?

  • I'm worried about adult acne and my acne won't go away
  • My skin problems do not improve even after visiting a dermatologist
  • The nose and forehead are sticky, but the eyes and mouth are dry.
  • I'm starting to notice dullness in my skin
  • I have a red rash that doesn't heal easily.

What you can learn from the skin diagnostic chart “RE-BEAU2”

With re-Beau2, you can investigate the following three basic items.

1Skin conditions that are difficult to see with the naked eye

The 24-megapixel high-definition color camera clearly shows skin conditions that are difficult to see with the naked eye.

2hidden stains

By using UV photography, we can show hidden stains that cannot be seen with regular photography, making them visible.

3Redness and pigment spots that are invisible on the surface

Redness photography visualizes redness hidden under excessive rubbing or pigment spots.

Benefits of receiving a beauty skin diagnosis

You can understand your skin condition in detail and objectively.

By combining color photos, UV photos, and redness photos, you can understand your current skin condition and hidden skin problems in detail and objectively.
This is especially recommended for those who are working hard on their skin care but are unable to see any results despite receiving treatment.

We can create a treatment plan that responds to each patient's individual skin problems and concerns.

Your doctor will give you advice based on the analysis results. After considering the patient's wishes, we can create a treatment plan that addresses your skin problems and concerns.

Patient motivation increases because highly predictable treatment is possible

The patient's motivation is also increased by narrowing down the cause and allowing treatment to be undertaken that is expected to be more effective. You can also take a more proactive approach to your daily skin care.

Flow of treatment

1counseling

A doctor will provide counseling. Please let us know your concerns, wishes, etc. in detail.

2face wash

For accurate diagnosis, you will be asked to wash your face to remove makeup, sebum, and dirt.

3re-Beau2 shooting

Three types of photos will be taken.
The shooting will be completed in about 10 to 15 minutes.

4Diagnosis and planning of future treatment plans

We will explain the analysis results in detail.
We will create a future treatment plan based on the doctor's advice and the patient's wishes.
Please rest assured that we will not provide unnecessary upsells.
